As per Chapter 15, Rule 11(2) of Madhya Pradesh High Court Rules, 2008, the service of notice upon the respondent No.2 be treated as deemed service.

This is the first application under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed by the applicant seeking grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.1422/2022 registered at Police Station Kowali, Guna District Guna for the offence punishable under Sections 420 of IPC.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State vehemently opposed the present anticipatory bail application and prayed for its rejection.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
7.
Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the rival parties, without commenting upon merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023.
8. Accordingly, present anticipatory bail application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of Investigating Officer/Investigating Agency.
